column1: # Spark-gap event table. SI units unless noted in SPARK_GAP_METRICS.md.
# Storage units: s
# event_index [1]: 0-based order of detected collapses. Used to plot conditioning.
# first_cycle [bool]: True when the preceding ramp is much flatter than the later population (startup / long plateau). Kept in the event table; excluded from typical stats.
# t_break [s]: Collapse-start time: first sample of the steepest ~20 ns drop. Event timestamp for all intervals; not the 1-sample voltage maximum.

# v_breakdown [V]: Median voltage over the ~20-50 ns plateau immediately before t_break. Repetitive breakdown voltage for that shot. Negative for a negative-polarity breakdown (an upward collapse from V < 0).
# v_undershoot [V]: Minimum in the ~200 ns after t_break. Includes inductive kick / probe ringing.
# v_residual [V]: Median voltage after ringing settles (~1-5 us post-edge)
column2: at the start of the next charging ramp. Recovery / restart voltage for the next cycle.

column1: # dv_collapse [V]: v_breakdown - v_undershoot. Total observed swing including undershoot.
# period_s [s]: t_break[i] - t_break[i-1]. Undefined for event 0.
# rep_rate_hz [Hz]: 1 / period_s for that interval.
# t_collapse_10_90 [s]: t90 - t10. IEC/scope 10-90% fall time of the discharge edge.
# slew_collapse_mean [V/s]: 0.8 * (v_pre - v_post) / t_collapse_10_90. Mean collapse gradient; a lower bound set by scope bandwidth.
# slew_collapse_peak [V/s]: Maximum |dV/dt| over a 5 ns window on the falling edge.
# t_ring [s]: Dominant post-collapse ring period in the 50-400 ns window (median peak spacing of the residual after a short moving mean).
# charge_rate [V/s]: Least-squares slope of the linear charging ramp from residual settle to ~100 ns before t_break. I ≈ C * charge_rate if C is known.
# charge_r2 [1]: Coefficient of determination of the linear ramp fit. Low R² flags a non-linear ramp.
# v_charge_start [V]: Voltage at the start of the ramp-fit window.
# v_charge_end [V]: Voltage at the end of the ramp-fit window (near v_breakdown).
# recovery_s [s]: Time from t_break until a short local slope matches the next-cycle charge rate. Duration of the post-spark transient.
# energy_j [J]: 0.5 * C * v_breakdown^2. Only when --capacitance is given.
# charge_c [C]: C * (v_breakdown - v_residual). Only when --capacitance is given.
# source_current_a [A]: C * charge_rate during the linear ramp. Only when --capacitance is given.
# L_est_h [H]: 1 / ((2π / t_ring)^2 * C) if t_ring and C are known.
